title: Private Chicago Foodie Tour
blurb:
Taste your way through Chicago on this private half-day walking food tour! Savor local favorites like Portillo’s hot dogs, Al’s Italian Beef, deep dish pizza, Garrett’s Popcorn, and Do-Rite Donuts while exploring top city landmarks such as the Tribune Tower, Wrigley Building, and Buckingham Fountain.

Led by a friendly local guide, this experience blends Chicago’s most famous eats, rich culture, and great photo ops — the perfect way to enjoy the best of the Windy City in one delicious day.

Tour Ticket Includes:
• 1 Portillo’s hot dog
• 1 small Garrett’s Popcorn
• 6" Al’s Italian Beef Sandwich
• 1 slice of authentic Chicago deep dish pizza
